title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements Quick Reference: Hold-Timing Rate on Extension Deposits
content:
The time left on the hold when the extension deposit is taken adds a hold-timing rate to the extension deposit rate on a reserved deal under the Vehicle Purchase Agreements.

**Clause.** Count the calendar days from the handling date to the deal's hold expiry date, the last day of the current hold.
- With **2 calendar days or fewer**, the hold-timing add-on is **1 percent**.
- With **more than 2 but not more than 4** calendar days, it is **0.5 percent**.
- With **more than 4** calendar days left, there is no hold-timing add-on.

| Calendar days from the handling date to the hold expiry date | Hold-timing add-on |
|---|---|
| 0, when the handling date is the expiry date itself | 1 percent |
| 1 | 1 percent |
| 2 | 1 percent |
| 3 | 0.5 percent |
| 4 | 0.5 percent |
| 5 or more | None |

**Input, judgement, output (hypothetical).**
- Handling date the 6th, hold expiry the 8th: 2 days left, which is "2 or fewer", so the add-on is 1 percent.
- Handling date the 6th, hold expiry the 10th: 4 days left, more than 2 and not more than 4, so the add-on is 0.5 percent.
- Handling date the 6th, hold expiry the 11th: 5 days left, more than 4, so there is no hold-timing add-on.

**Basis note.** The days are calendar days counted between the two dates, with no business-day adjustment.
